Overview

Guwahati is a city in Assam with a population of 1,200,000. The largest city in Northeast India, a gateway to the Seven Sister states, known for its temples, wildlife, and Brahmaputra River. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
